title: audit seal: review follow-ups of PR #37605 (sealed expiry) — notices, pins, the chain plan and taking a floor back
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (contract review records on PR #37605, Part of #31908: 7198128323 and its delta rounds through 7213680494)

## What happens

PR #37605 makes a sealed object's rows expire only through a registered, signed seam, with a retention floor, for objects whose lifecycle is declared in packaged metadata. Its review left these nits open, each accepted for a follow-up:

- [ ] **n11: no run-time notice when a tenant window is set and not applied** (`expiry.ts`, `lifecycle-service.ts`). The three texts carry the cost; the sweep reports the object like any other. A once-only notice naming the object and the column.
- [ ] **n12: no resume pin holds more than one page** (`audit-seal-expiry-admission.test.ts`). The second page of the paged read runs in no test; a backlog of more than twenty checkpoints is ordinary.
- [ ] **n13: `plan()` finds chains by the latest cutoff any window allows** (`expiry.ts`). Where the windows sit on another column, every chain with a checkpoint that old is opened to take nothing. Find them by the longest window's cutoff in that case.
- [ ] **n15: the floor rule holds by registration** (`audit-plugin.ts`). If a refresh throws, the expiry stays registered and later objects in that call are skipped. Nothing shipped throws there; a check in the expiry itself, against the declaration the registry holds, would hold the rule without registration.
- [ ] **n16: a floor is never taken back** (`retention-floor.ts`, `lifecycle-service.ts`). After `seal` is dropped or `archive` added, the last floor stays until restart. Taking it back needs a disposer on a public method.
- [ ] **n18: no test saves a sealed definition through the metadata door on a real kernel and sweeps it.** The real-kernel SQLite run is the place.
- [ ] **n21: two cases named, three exist.** The describe, `objects.mdx` and the changeset name "declared in packaged metadata" and "created at runtime"; an object registered from code under a package id no installed `code` or `marketplace` package answers also keeps the row-cutoff sweep (seat reading 7212989029 on #31908). Say "any other sealed object".

## Done when

Each box above is fixed, or closed with a reason.

Grade: area:data · bug · reach: audit seal expiry hardening, tests and docs wording · evidence: the review records above
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: M
Related: PR #37605, #31908.
